notes: Hard-cap furnishing baseline: $4,904.12; unit-range extension $4,709.12-$5,736.71. Root handles sales tax. General freight is excluded unless seller states free; verify at checkout.

Excluded optional/reference extension: $8,869.00. It includes the Zephyr cooler, original Trinity stools, uncertain 17 Stories table, Tully pedestal-table upgrade, custom coffee table/rug alternates, Ruggable alternates, NPS desk, FLINTAN chair, optional piano move and rack fan.
Selected sofa plus two DYVLINGE chairs remain $1,650.99. No purchase or ownership is implied until order/receipt records exist.

Baseline bar remains 48 x 26 x 42 in and uses two 3/4-in plywood sheets plus one 1/2-in 24 x 48-in project panel. Each 48 x 10-in shelf bonds one 0.703-in base blank to one 0.453-in supplemental layer for an approximately 1.156-in unfinished thickness; Titebond II and six of the fourteen paid bar hours cover the shelf glue-up and finish. Printed Blackstone laminate, acrylic/smoke-film infill and decorative gold trim remain disclosed material substitutions; powered lighting and electrician work remain root scope.

Baseline has no refrigerator. The future bay is capped/removable and passively vented; the $1,499 Zephyr is phased optional. No countertop freestanding refrigerator is proposed because cabinet ventilation/service fit is not proven.

Three selected Safavieh FOX3230C stools are exactly 13.5 in wide, totaling 40.5 in across a 48-in run and leaving 3.75-in internal gaps with flush outer edges. This solves bare width arithmetic but still requires a full occupied mockup.

Current-room.jpeg documents at least one black worktable and a rolling chair, but no dimensions, maker, load rating or condition. Baseline conditionally retains them at $0 after field verification. The 72 x 30-in NPS bench and FLINTAN chair are priced, excluded fallbacks. The external open 12U rack remains a new base item.

The accepted 30 x 16-in pedestal coffee table changes to a 30.7 x 18.5-in Qualler black tempered-glass/gold-frame table; the pedestal silhouette changes to an open geometric frame. The accepted true 9 x 10-ft rug changes to an actual 7.8 x 10.25-ft rug. Tape and update both before claiming fit.

Inventory documents a Yamaha Clavinova and piano bench, not the accepted NU1X. Baseline makes no piano purchase and does not claim NU1X ownership; Greg must accept the retained-model substitution or provide separate piano direction.
Six instruments are documented: one guitar and five basses. Four display positions stay empty. No instrument acquisition allowance or purchase is included.

Root AV owns rack power conditioning, signal/display/network cables, labeling, patchbay and commissioning. Root PWR owns receptacles/circuits/electrician labor. This schedule owns the physical rack/desk/trays/grommets and studio-assistant assembly only.

Studio-assistant labor is an independent $35-$50/hour planning allowance, not a contractor quote. Specialty piano handling remains excluded until the exact retained console and move need are verified.
